title: Refund Controls for Companion Charges — Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
Every refund of a charge on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product is subject to the following controls.

1. **Once per charge.** Each charge entry can be refunded at most once. The trip and charge history of the certificate or pass shows whether a refund entry already names that charge; where one does, the charge is not refunded again.
2. **Amount.** The clause "a refund equals the amount of the charge it names" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for each refund.
3. **Grounds.** A refund is made only for a companion ticket that was cancelled or whose charge was made in error; a flown companion trip is never refunded.

| Hypothetical charge | Refund may be made |
|---|---|
| Charge on a companion ticket that was cancelled, not yet refunded | yes |
| Charge made in error, not yet refunded | yes |
| Charge already named by an earlier refund entry | no |
| Charge on a flown companion trip | no |

superseded_clauses: a refund equals the amount of the charge it names
